# SDKs (/sdks)

- [TypeScript](/sdks/typescript): [Download SDK](/__downloads/sdk/typescript.zip)
- [Python](/sdks/python): [Download SDK](/__downloads/sdk/python.zip)

# Python SDK (/sdks/python)

[Download SDK](/__downloads/sdk/python.zip)

## Intro [#intro]

The GridWindow FlexPay API SDK provides access to the GridWindow FlexPay API REST APIs.

The public driver API behind GridWindow FlexPay, plus the operator endpoints.

**Flow.** A driver (or an AI agent acting for one, see `docs/MCP.md`) reads the site, requests priced offers,
optionally asks the deal agent for a pick, then accepts one exact offer. Accepting creates a PayPal Orders v2
**AUTHORIZE** order and returns an `approveUrl`; only the human buyer can approve it in PayPal. The server then
authorizes, commits the charging slots, and later captures for delivered energy or voids. The client never sets a price
and never moves money.

**Sessions.** Driver identity is a signed `gw_drv` cookie created on the first quote. Operator endpoints need the
`gw_op` cookie from `POST /api/operator/session`. Mutating requests must come from an allowed origin (`Origin` header).

**Money.** All amounts are integer US cents. Payments are PayPal **Sandbox** (test money) or a labelled MOCK provider.

## Installation [#installation]

Add the SDK to your project from its folder, with whichever package manager your project uses. Give each tool a path containing a slash, such as `../grid-window-flex-pay-api` — a bare folder name is looked up on PyPI instead, and resolves to whatever project holds that name there:

```bash
pip install <path-to-sdk>
```

```bash
uv add <path-to-sdk>
```

```bash
poetry add <path-to-sdk>
```

## Quick Start [#quick-start]

### Synchronous client [#synchronous-client]

Construct `GridWindowFlexPayApiClient` with keyword arguments, and call `close()` when you are done. Every argument is optional.

```python
from grid_window_flex_pay_api import GridWindowFlexPayApiClient

client = GridWindowFlexPayApiClient(operator_cookie="YOUR_API_KEY", environment="production")

client.close()
```

Alternatively, scope it — `with GridWindowFlexPayApiClient(...) as client:` closes the pool on exit.

### Asynchronous client [#asynchronous-client]

`AsyncGridWindowFlexPayApiClient` mirrors `GridWindowFlexPayApiClient` with **identical method names**, and every endpoint method is a coroutine. It takes the same arguments, with some differences — for example, the transport argument is `custom_async_http_client`.

```python
from asyncio import run

from grid_window_flex_pay_api import AsyncGridWindowFlexPayApiClient

async def main() -> None:
    client = AsyncGridWindowFlexPayApiClient(operator_cookie="YOUR_API_KEY", environment="production")
    await client.aclose()

run(main())
```

Alternatively, scope it — `async with AsyncGridWindowFlexPayApiClient(...) as client:` closes the pool on exit.

# TypeScript SDK (/sdks/typescript)

[Download SDK](/__downloads/sdk/typescript.zip)

## Intro [#intro]

The GridWindow FlexPay API SDK provides access to the GridWindow FlexPay API REST APIs.

The public driver API behind GridWindow FlexPay, plus the operator endpoints.

**Flow.** A driver (or an AI agent acting for one, see `docs/MCP.md`) reads the site, requests priced offers,
optionally asks the deal agent for a pick, then accepts one exact offer. Accepting creates a PayPal Orders v2
**AUTHORIZE** order and returns an `approveUrl`; only the human buyer can approve it in PayPal. The server then
authorizes, commits the charging slots, and later captures for delivered energy or voids. The client never sets a price
and never moves money.

**Sessions.** Driver identity is a signed `gw_drv` cookie created on the first quote. Operator endpoints need the
`gw_op` cookie from `POST /api/operator/session`. Mutating requests must come from an allowed origin (`Origin` header).

**Money.** All amounts are integer US cents. Payments are PayPal **Sandbox** (test money) or a labelled MOCK provider.

## Installation [#installation]

The SDK compiles to `dist/` before it can be referenced — run its `build` script once in the SDK folder, then add it to your project by path:

```bash
npm install <path-to-sdk>
```

## Quick Start [#quick-start]

Create one client and reuse it. Configure its behaviour through `ClientOptions`.

```ts
import { GridWindowFlexPayApiClient, ServerEnvironment } from "grid-window-flex-pay-api";

const client = new GridWindowFlexPayApiClient({
  serverEnvironment: ServerEnvironment.Production,
  operatorCookie: "YOUR_API_KEY",
});
```

Nothing in `ClientOptions` is required — `new GridWindowFlexPayApiClient()` compiles — and each option left out falls back to its default. `serverEnvironment` is spelled out above so the environment a call reaches is visible where the client is built rather than inherited silently.

### From CommonJS [#from-commonjs]

The package ships both dialects from a single entry, so `require` works with full types. In a TypeScript CommonJS file use the `import ... = require(...)` form — a plain destructuring `require` runs fine but gives you `any`.

```ts
import sdk = require("grid-window-flex-pay-api");

const client = new sdk.GridWindowFlexPayApiClient({
  serverEnvironment: sdk.ServerEnvironment.Production,
  operatorCookie: "YOUR_API_KEY",
});
```

# Station, ports, payment mode, AI status and the default charging window (/api/openapi/site/getSiteConfig)

`GET /api/config`

Station, ports, payment mode, AI status and the default charging window.

# Turn a plain-language request into form fields (/api/openapi/ai/parseChargingRequest)

`POST /api/quotes/parse`

Fills a form only. It sets no price and approves nothing. Falls back to a labelled deterministic parser when no AI provider is available.

# Ask the deal agent to pick one of the caller's offers for a goal (/api/openapi/ai/recommendOffer)

`POST /api/agent/deals`

Read-only. It evaluates only offers the backend already priced and never accepts or pays.

# Explain one of the caller's offers in plain language (/api/openapi/ai/explainOffer)

`POST /api/assist/explain`

Numbers come from the stored quote; model text is checked against them before it is shown.

# Ask a question about one of the caller's reservations (/api/openapi/ai/askAboutReservation)

`POST /api/assist/ask`

Ask a question about one of the caller's reservations.

# Request priced charging offers for one port and night (/api/openapi/offers/requestOffers)

`POST /api/quotes`

Creates the driver session cookie if absent. Each offer carries exact terms and their SHA-256 `termsHash`, which accept must echo.

# Accept one exact, unexpired offer and create the PayPal authorize order (/api/openapi/checkout/acceptOffer)

`POST /api/offers/accept`

Requires the driver's explicit consent (`consent: true`) and the `termsHash` the driver saw; tampered or expired
terms are refused. Returns the PayPal approval link. Nothing is authorized or charged until the buyer approves in PayPal.


# PayPal return URL. Authorizes the approved order, then redirects to the reservation (/api/openapi/checkout/checkoutReturn)

`GET /api/checkout/return`

PayPal return URL. Authorizes the approved order, then redirects to the reservation.

# PayPal cancel URL. Cancels the pending order, then redirects to the reservation (/api/openapi/checkout/checkoutCancel)

`GET /api/checkout/cancel`

PayPal cancel URL. Cancels the pending order, then redirects to the reservation.

# Reservations made in the caller's driver session (/api/openapi/reservations/listMyReservations)

`GET /api/reservations`

Reservations made in the caller's driver session.

# One reservation with payment state, provider proofs and receipt data (/api/openapi/reservations/getReservation)

`GET /api/reservations/{id}`

One reservation with payment state, provider proofs and receipt data.

# Whether the caller holds an operator session (/api/openapi/operator/getOperatorSession)

`GET /api/operator/session`

Whether the caller holds an operator session.

# Sign in with the operator passphrase (/api/openapi/operator/operatorSignIn)

`POST /api/operator/session`

Sign in with the operator passphrase.

# Sign out (/api/openapi/operator/operatorSignOut)

`DELETE /api/operator/session`

Sign out.

# Every reservation of a night with load, ports and payment states (/api/openapi/operator/getOperatorDashboard)

`GET /api/operator/dashboard`

Every reservation of a night with load, ports and payment states.

# PayPal Sandbox webhook receiver (/api/openapi/webhooks/paypalWebhook)

`POST /api/webhooks/paypal`

Verifies the PayPal signature against the unaltered body, then re-reads provider state. A webhook alone never marks a payment captured or voided.
